pdf.method: All eight pages rendered with Poppler on the Linux host at 1100-pixel long edge and visually inspected. Tables, figures, body text, headers and page numbers were checked; no clipping or overlapping text observed.

demo.method: Inspected overview, all three case titles, motion/REPLAN examples, both outcomes for each pair, and closing card. Full frame count, dimensions and source matching were checked by the builder; visual QA used sampled frames.

state_outcomes: Inspected the three task panels showing all ten states and all five K values, with binary outcome cells.
